'''Dusk Squadron''' was a unit of elite [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. They were assigned by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Beldiss]] to eliminate the Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Malcom Terrax]] on [[Voss]] but their work was prevented, due to the intervention of a prominent [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] individual.
